{{< video videos/dna_morph.mp4 >}}

ProteinMotion morphs chain A of 1BNA into chain A of 2DCG with C1′ anchors and a
     per-residue delay. That needs the planned `Morph To Attribute` node, so this storyboard
     turns the source, cuts to the target, reframes and adds ball-and-stick.

After ProteinMotion's [`dna_morph.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/dna_morph.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/dna_morph.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/dna_morph.py"}
{{< include scripts/dna_morph.py >}}
```
